def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # angle to enemy (-180..180, positive left)
    ang = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

    # higher base throttle for aggression, but back off a bit when very close
    base = 0.85 if dist > 1.2 else 0.6

    # proportional turn, limited
    turn = max(-0.6, min(0.6, ang / 80.0))

    left = base - turn
    right = base + turn
